note: Troop roles and usage notes are PekkaDex summaries. Housing space, levels and damage numbers are deliberately not listed: they change with balance updates and are not part of the verified data set. Super Troop icons are the art already in the repository.

troops.name: Barbarian
troops.use: The first troop in the game. Numbers beat quality; they clear the outside ring while something tankier walks behind.

troops.name: Archer
troops.use: Ranged chip damage behind a tank. They are also the reason a Queen Walk needs a clean edge to work.

troops.name: Giant
troops.use: Walks straight at the nearest defence. Everything else in the army is there to keep up with him.

troops.name: Goblin
troops.use: Ignores everything except resources. The classic farm-then-leave troop.

troops.name: Wall Breaker
troops.use: Opens the compartment you actually want. Deploy them after the tank has pulled the splash.

troops.name: Balloon
troops.use: Slow, fragile, enormous damage. It needs a Lava Hound or a Warden to reach the core.

troops.name: Wizard
troops.use: Clears skeletons and clustered buildings behind a tank. Fragile to any splash defence.

troops.name: Healer
troops.use: Keeps a Queen Walk or a tank push alive. Healing does not stack well past a couple of healers.

troops.name: Dragon
troops.use: One big flying body that ignores walls. Mass Dragons is the classic first air army.

troops.name: P.E.K.K.A
troops.use: Slow, huge single-target damage. Gets distracted easily, so funnel her first.

troops.name: Baby Dragon
troops.use: Strong alone, weaker in a group. Best used on the outside to pick off collectors.

troops.name: Miner
troops.use: Travels underground and surfaces under defences, ignoring walls entirely.

troops.name: Electro Dragon
troops.use: Chains lightning between buildings. Slow, so it needs a funnel and a rage.

troops.name: Yeti
troops.use: Tanky melee that spawns smaller bodies when it is hurt. Good in smash attacks.

troops.name: Dragon Rider
troops.use: Flies quickly and hits hard, but it is expensive and needs a plan for air defences.

troops.name: Root Rider
troops.use: A ground tank that walks through walls. The core of most modern smash armies.

troops.name: Hog Rider
troops.use: Jumps walls and goes straight for defences. Dies instantly to a giant bomb.

troops.name: Minion
troops.use: Cheap flying chip. Excellent for cleaning up the last few percent.

troops.name: Valkyrie
troops.use: Splash melee that shreds clustered buildings. Funnel her or she circles the base.

troops.name: Golem
troops.use: The original wall of hit points. Splits into smaller golems when destroyed.

troops.name: Witch
troops.use: Keeps spawning skeletons. Slow, but she creates her own funnel.

troops.name: Lava Hound
troops.use: Absorbs air-defence fire and drops lava pups when it dies. Made for LavaLoon.

troops.name: Bowler
troops.use: Rocks bounce between buildings. Strong in a tight core, weak on spread bases.

troops.name: Ice Golem
troops.use: Freezes defences on death. Used to buy a few seconds for the main push.

troops.name: Headhunter
troops.use: Targets heroes specifically. Deploy her once the defending hero is committed.

troops.name: Super Barbarian
troops.use: Bigger Barbarian with far more hit points and damage. Uses the Barbarian slot.

troops.name: Super Archer
troops.use: Longer range and more damage than an Archer. Uses the Archer slot.

troops.name: Super Giant
troops.use: A Giant that hits harder and survives longer. Uses the Giant slot.

troops.name: Super Wall Breaker
troops.use: A much larger wall breaker with a bigger blast. Uses the Wall Breaker slot.

troops.name: Super Wizard
troops.use: Faster, harder-hitting splash. Uses the Wizard slot.

troops.name: Super Dragon
troops.use: A bigger Dragon with a heavier breath. Uses the Dragon slot.

troops.name: Super Minion
troops.use: A tougher Minion with a longer range. Uses the Minion slot.

troops.name: Super Hog Rider
troops.use: A Hog Rider that survives splash better. Uses the Hog Rider slot.

troops.name: Super Valkyrie
troops.use: A Valkyrie with a wider spin and more health. Uses the Valkyrie slot.

troops.name: Super Witch
troops.use: Summons a much bigger skeleton. Uses the Witch slot.

troops.name: Super Bowler
troops.use: Bouncing rocks with more power. Uses the Bowler slot.

troops.name: Super Ice Hound
troops.use: An air tank that freezes on death. Uses the Lava Hound slot.

troops.name: Inferno Dragon
troops.use: Ramps up damage on one target. Best sent at a core defence after the air defences are busy.

troops.name: Super Inferno Dragon
troops.use: A heavier Inferno Dragon beam. Uses the Inferno Dragon slot.

troops.name: Super Miner
troops.use: A Miner that burrows faster and hits harder. Uses the Miner slot.

troops.name: Rocket Balloon
troops.use: A Balloon with a rocket boost. Uses the Balloon slot.

troops.name: Sneaky Goblin
troops.use: A Goblin that stays invisible until it attacks. Uses the Goblin slot.
